hypotheses.mechanism: Chiller temperature lowering from 20C to -20C reduces radical activity and side-wall polymer deposition control, improving profile verticality.

hypotheses.observed_trend: For CHF3, top_bottom_ratio decreased from 4.0 (20C) to 2.9 (-20C). For C3H2F6, top_bottom_ratio decreased from 3.0 (20C) to 1.6 (-20C).

hypotheses.mechanism: Changing gas chemistry from CHF3 to C3H2F6 alters polymer precursor ratio and F/C ratio, enhancing anisotropic etching and reducing taper.
hypotheses.predicted_trend: Switching gas from CHF3 to C3H2F6 decreases top_bottom_ratio.
hypotheses.observed_trend: At 20C, top_bottom_ratio decreased from 4.0 (CHF3) to 3.0 (C3H2F6). At -20C, top_bottom_ratio decreased from 2.9 (CHF3) to 1.6 (C3H2F6).
